crossRefs.note: Surely men of low degree are just a breath, and men of high degree are a lie. In the balances they will go up. They are…
Don’t trust in oppression. Don’t become vain in robbery. If riches increase, don’t set your heart on them.
I was so senseless and ignorant. I was a brute beast before you.
A senseless man doesn’t know, neither does a fool understand this:
I said in my heart, “As for the sons of men, God tests them, so that they may see that they themselves are like animals.
Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,
But do you want to know, vain man, that faith apart from works is dead?
He takes the wise in their own craftiness; the counsel of the cunning is carried headlong.
“No doubt, but you are the people, and wisdom will die with you.
But I have understanding as well as you; I am not inferior to you. Yes, who doesn’t know such things as these?
To man he said, ‘Behold, the fear of the Lord, that is wisdom. To depart from evil is understanding.’ ”
“Surely I am the most ignorant man, and don’t have a man’s understanding.
Be of the same mind one toward another. Don’t set your mind on high things, but associate with the humble. Don’t be…
Let no one deceive himself. If anyone thinks that he is wise among you in this world, let him become a fool, that he…
Who is wise and understanding among you? Let him show by his good conduct that his deeds are done in gentleness of…
What is man, that he should be clean? What is he who is born of a woman, that he should be righteous?
Behold, I was born in iniquity. My mother conceived me in sin.
We also all once lived among them in the lusts of our flesh, doing the desires of the flesh and of the mind, and were…
Does the wild donkey bray when he has grass? Or does the ox low over his fodder?
“Who has set the wild donkey free? Or who has loosened the bonds of the swift donkey,
a wild donkey used to the wilderness, that sniffs the wind in her craving. When she is in heat, who can turn her away?…

translations.web: An empty-headed man becomes wise when a man is born as a wild donkey’s colt.
translations.bsb: But a witless man can no more become wise than the colt of a wild donkey can be born a man!
translations.kjv: For vain man would be wise, though man be born like a wild ass's colt.
translations.asv: But vain man is void of understanding, Yea, man is born as a wild ass's colt.
